question: Food establishment has an updated FSSAI license and is displayed at a prominent location.
The design of food premises provides adequate working space; permit maintenance & cleaning to prevent entry of dirt, dust & pests.
The internal structure & fittings are made of non-toxic and impermeable material.
Walls, ceilings & doors are free from flaking paint or plaster, condensation & shedding particles.
Floors are non-absorbent, non-slippery & sloped appropriately.
Windows are kept closed & fitted with insect proof screen when opening to external environment.
Doors are smooth and non-absorbent. Suitable precautions taken to prevent entry of pests.
Potable water (meeting standards of IS:10500 & tested semi-annually with records maintained thereof) is used as product ingredient or in contact with food or food contact surface.
Equipment and containers are made of non-toxic, impervious, non-corrosive material which is easy to clean & disinfect.
Adequate facilities for heating, cooling, refrigeration and freezing food & facilitate monitoring of temperature.
Premise has sufficient lighting. Lighting fixtures are protected to prevent contamination on breakage.
Adequate ventilation is provided within the premises.
An adequate storage facility for food, packaging materials, chemicals, personnel items etc is available.
Personnel hygiene facilities are available including adequate number of hand washing facilities, toilets, change rooms for employees.
Food material is tested either through internal laboratory or through an accredited lab. Check for records.
Incoming material is procured as per internally laid down specification from approved vendors. Check for records (CoA, Form E, specs, supplier, batch, expiry).
Raw materials are inspected at the time of receiving for food safety hazards (farm produce checked for spoilage and accepted in good condition).
Incoming material, semi or final products stored per temperature in hygienic environment. FIFO & FEFO practiced (animal origin <= 4°C).
All raw materials is cleaned thoroughly before food preparation.
Proper segregation of raw, cooked; vegetarian and non-vegetarian food is done.
All the equipment is adequately sanitized before and after food preparation.
Frozen food is thawed hygienically. No thawed food stored for later use (meat/fish/poultry in fridge <=5°C or microwave; seafood cold running water <=15°C within 90m).
Vegetarian cooked min 60°C/10m or 65°C/2m core temp. Non-veg min 65°C/10m or 70°C/2m or 75°C/15s core temp.
Cooked food intended for refrigeration cooled appropriately (high risk cooled from 60°C to 21°C within 2h, further to 5°C within 2h).
Food portioning done hygienically. High risk portioned in refrigerated area or refrigerated within 30 min. Large amount below 15°C.
Hot food held at >=65°C, non-veg >=70°C. Cold foods <=5°C, frozen <=-18°C.
Reheating done appropriately (core temp 75°C for 2 min). No indirect reheating like bain-marie or hot lamp.
Oil suitable for cooking used. Periodic verification of fat/oil color, flavour and floated elements done.
Vehicles for food transport kept clean, good repair, maintain required temp (hot >=65°C, cold <=5°C, frozen <=-18°C or transported within 2h).
Food and non-food transported at same time in same vehicle separated adequately.
Cutlery, crockery and dinner accompaniments clean and sanitized free from unhygienic matters.
Packaging and wrapping material in contact with food is clean and food grade.
Cleaning of equipment and premises per schedule & programme. No water stagnation in food zones.
Preventive maintenance carried out per manufacturer instructions. Check records.
Measuring & monitoring devices calibrated periodically.
Pest control program available & carried out by trained personnel. Check records.
No signs of pest activity or infestation in premises (eggs, larvae, faeces etc).
Drains meet expected flow loads, equipped with grease and cockroach traps.
Food waste and refuse removed periodically to avoid accumulation.
Annual medical examination & inoculation against enteric diseases per schedule done. Check records.
No person with illness or open wounds/burns involved in handling food.
Food handlers maintain personal cleanliness (clean clothes, trimmed nails & waterproof bandage) and behaviour (hand washing, no jewellery/smoking/spitting).
Food handlers equipped with suitable aprons, gloves, headgear etc wherever necessary.
Internal / External audit of system done periodically. Check records.
Food business has an effective consumer complaints redressal mechanism.
Food handlers trained and skilled to handle food safely. Check training records.
Appropriate documentation & records available and retained for 1 year or shelf-life, whichever is more.
